name: Dora Dobrotić — a son Jacobus baptised in 1871, Križovljan Radovečki, Croatia
researcher_question: Which children were born to Dora (Dorothea) Dobrotić, born about 1841 at Veliki Lovrečan, Varaždin, Croatia, and her husband Franjo Korotaj?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 7, hint-samples.csv row 228, flag adds_son, confidence 3). Draft transcribed from a Croatian Catholic church-book entry indexing the baptism of Jacobus Korota on 3 April 1871 at Križovljan Radovečki, son of Franciscus Korota and Dorothea Dobrotić; unverified. The entry's image sits in a Kotoriba death register for 1890-1917, so the record type itself needs checking.
